bugs.title: Misplaced overflow return always exits FP16 optimizer step
bugs.root_cause: return self.overflow at wrong indentation causes optimizer step to always return early
bugs.invariant: return self.overflow must be inside if self.overflow block, not if use_grad_scaling
bugs.detection_method: source_analysis

bugs.title: Loss not decreasing when using overlap-param-gather with overlap-grad-reduce
bugs.root_cause: All-gather handle list in DistributedOptimizer not properly initialized. Causes stale handles, which makes FP16 loss scaler always detect inf, setting LR=0 and skipping all parameter updates.
bugs.invariant: After warmup, learning_rate > 0 and loss must decrease. All iterations skipped or LR=0 = bug.
bugs.detection_method: loss_trend

bugs.title: MoE Router topk=1 with post-softmax gives trivial probabilities and zero gradient
bugs.root_cause: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax of single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn.
bugs.invariant: Router routing probabilities must have non-trivial distribution. All probs == 1.0 means zero gradient = bug.
bugs.detection_method: value_invariant

bugs.title: preserve_rng_state incorrectly set to False with dropout
bugs.root_cause: Boolean condition inverted: preserve_rng_state = (all_dropout==0) instead of not(all_dropout==0)
bugs.invariant: When dropout > 0, preserve_rng_state must be True
bugs.detection_method: config_invariant

bugs.title: Integer overflow when tracking global flops
bugs.root_cause: global_train_flops: int overflows after ~107K steps for 7B models
bugs.invariant: global flops tracking must use float to avoid overflow
bugs.detection_method: value_invariant

bugs.title: A100 peak flops specification 2x too low
bugs.root_cause: A100 BF16 peak = 624 TFLOPS but code used 312 TFLOPS, inflating MFU to unrealistic values.
bugs.invariant: A100 BF16 peak flops must be 624 TFLOPS, not 312
bugs.detection_method: value_invariant

bugs.title: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors (>= 2^31 elements)
bugs.root_cause: TensorListMetadata 的 sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行，参数和 optimizer state 不更新
bugs.detection_method: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零

bugs.title: Missing input validation for fp16 loss_scale accepts float('inf')
bugs.root_cause: fp16 配置的 loss_scale 接受 float('inf') 而不报错，导致梯度被 inf 缩放后悄悄变成 NaN
bugs.detection_method: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error

bugs.title: Fix ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offloaded gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
bugs.root_cause: ga_steps > 1 条件阻止了 ga_steps=1 但有多次 backward 场景的梯度累积，中间 backward 的梯度被丢弃，参数偏差达 2e-3
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差

bugs.title: Fix zero 1 and 2 CPU-offloaded gradient norm
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 场景下 micro_step_id > 0 的梯度被丢弃而非累积到 CPU，导致梯度范数在首个 microstep 后冻结，严重低估真实梯度幅度
bugs.detection_method: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长

bugs.title: Fix: Update grad norm calculation for CPU offload
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 下 gradient clipping 后 norm_for_param_grads 数据结构未更新，导致记录的梯度范数与实际 clipped 梯度不一致，梯度裁剪效果失效
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配

bugs.title: Fix sort of zero checkpoint files
bugs.root_cause: checkpoint 转换工具按字母顺序排序分片文件（10, 11, 9 而非 9, 10, 11），导致 optimizer state 碎片合并顺序错误，checkpoint 数据静默损坏
bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配

bugs.title: Fix saving and loading model checkpoint logic for MiCS sharding
bugs.root_cause: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失；加载时也缺少对 MiCS partition 的支持
bugs.detection_method: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据

bugs.title: MOE: Fix save checkpoint when TP > 1
bugs.root_cause: MoE checkpoint 保存仅保留 rank 0 的 model_states 文件，TP > 1 时其他 TP rank 的数据缺失
bugs.detection_method: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件

bugs.title: seq_aux_loss + pad_to_capacity produces corrupted routing map and wrong load balancing loss
bugs.root_cause: When pad_to_capacity is enabled, dummy padded tokens corrupt the routing_map used for load-balancing loss computation. The auxiliary loss becomes constantly 1.0 instead of reflecting true token distribution across experts.
bugs.detection_method: Auxiliary load balancing loss is constant 1.0; routing_map includes padded tokens with zero probabilities

bugs.title: Incorrect softmax_factor in MLA using mscale instead of mscale_all_dim
bugs.root_cause: Multi-Head Latent Attention uses wrong scaling variable (mscale vs mscale_all_dim) for softmax_factor calculation. No error is thrown but attention scaling is mathematically incorrect, diverging from DeepSeek-V3 reference.
bugs.detection_method: Softmax scale factor value differs from reference implementation; attention output diverges

bugs.title: Fix data helpers overflow bug (int32 overflow in sample_idx)
bugs.root_cause: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32). When doc_idx_index exceeds int32 range during long training with short-sentence datasets, silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices, feeding incorrect training samples.
bugs.detection_method: sample_idx wraps around due to int32 overflow; wrong documents/samples are loaded for training

bugs.title: MXFP8 params without DP comm overlap causes NaN loss
bugs.root_cause: Using --fp8-param-gather and --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather causes gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN. The gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication.
bugs.detection_method: Loss becomes NaN; gradient buffer values corrupted due to premature reuse before communication completes

bugs.title: Fix bug of reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag
bugs.root_cause: When forward_pre_hook is disabled, finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration, so initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.
bugs.detection_method: Gradient buffer contains non-zero values before first backward; grad_norm abnormally large on first iteration

bugs.title: Optimizer state is empty when save-interval=20
bugs.root_cause: When saving checkpoint at iteration 20 with save-interval=20, optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key. The optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints.
bugs.detection_method: Checkpoint optimizer state is missing exp_avg/exp_avg_sq; KeyError on resume

bugs.title: Sequential OLMo block should not have shared layernorm
bugs.root_cause: Sequential transformer block 中 attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2，导致两路归一化参数耦合
bugs.detection_method: FFN 路径和 attention 路径的 LayerNorm 输出完全相同（应该不同）；模型训练效果不佳但不会 crash

bugs.title: Changed from ignored_index to ignore_index for cross_entropy_loss (flash-attn API change)
bugs.root_cause: flash-attn >= 2.5.8 将 cross_entropy_loss 的参数名从 ignored_index 改为 ignore_index，但 OLMo 未同步更新，导致 ignore_index 参数未生效，padding token 被错误地计入 loss
bugs.detection_method: loss 值偏低（padding token 参与了 loss 计算使分母变大）；模型对 padding 位置产生了非零梯度

bugs.title: Fix bug with saving unsharded checkpoint
bugs.root_cause: 保存 unsharded checkpoint 时存在 bug，导致 checkpoint 状态不完整或不正确，从该 checkpoint 恢复训练会产生错误结果
bugs.detection_method: 从 unsharded checkpoint 恢复训练后，loss 与中断前不连续

bugs.title: Instance mask correction to avoid NaN loss
bugs.root_cause: Instance masking 实现中存在 bug，当 batch 中所有 token 都被 mask 时导致除以零产生 NaN loss
bugs.detection_method: 特定 batch 上 loss 突然变为 NaN；与 instance mask 中的全零 mask 相关

bugs.title: Fixed CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler initialization bug
bugs.root_cause: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay 学习率 scheduler 的初始化逻辑错误，导致学习率 schedule 不符合预期
bugs.detection_method: 实际 learning rate schedule 与配置的 cosine+warmup+linear decay 不匹配

bugs.title: Fixed LM evaluator data-order drift across repeated runs via loader bookkeeping reset
bugs.root_cause: LM evaluator 的 data loader 在重复运行间存在数据顺序漂移，因为 bookkeeping state 未被正确重置，导致不同 eval run 看到不同顺序的数据
bugs.detection_method: 相同配置下多次 evaluation 结果不一致；data loader 的内部 index 状态在 run 之间未重置

bugs.title: Initialization bug in Attention/GatedDeltaNet: depth-scaled output projection init never applied
bugs.root_cause: Attention 和 GatedDeltaNet 中 depth-scaled output projection 初始化由于错误的自比较运算符（self-equality check）而从未生效，初始化使用了错误的 scale
bugs.detection_method: output projection 的初始化权重 scale 与配置的 depth-scaled init 不匹配；所有层的 output projection scale 相同（应随深度变化）

bugs.title: FSDP gradient accumulation outside no_sync() with CPU offloading yields incorrect results
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 no_sync() 外部做 gradient accumulation 且使用 CPU offloading 时，直接使用新 reduce 的梯度替代累积梯度，而非叠加
bugs.detection_method: gradient accumulation 时梯度未被正确累积；每次 accumulation step 的梯度覆盖了之前的梯度

bugs.title: FSDP use_orig_params + full sharding results in missing parameters in gathered state dict
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD 策略下，inner module 的 state_dict 缺少部分子模块的参数，而 wrapped model 的 state_dict 包含正确的参数
bugs.detection_method: state_dict 中缺少部分参数；inner module 和 wrapped model 的 state_dict key 不一致

bugs.title: FSDP with param_init_fn + sync_module_states=True produces random accuracy (model not learning)
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 使用 param_init_fn 和 sync_module_states=True 时，因 re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变了参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同，模型实际上无法学习但不报错
bugs.detection_method: accuracy 和 F1 保持随机水平（模型未学习）；loss 看似下降但实际效果为零

bugs.title: Fixed bug attempting to save duplicate final checkpoint on restart
bugs.root_cause: 训练从 checkpoint 恢复后，trainer 尝试重复保存最终 checkpoint，可能覆盖已有的正确 checkpoint
bugs.detection_method: 恢复训练后在最终 step 保存了重复的 checkpoint；checkpoint 文件被覆盖
